title: Coulomb's law and superposition (3D, 2D)
description: A charged ring (3-D) and a pair of finite line charges (2-D cross-section) built from N point charges by superposition, against the closed forms; the error falls as N grows.

metrics.name: rel_error[3D: ring potential at s = 0.6 R, z = 0.3 R]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: Jackson sec. 3.3: phi = Q/(4 pi eps0) (2/pi) K(m)/sqrt((R+s)^2+z^2))

metrics.name: rel_error[3D: axial field E_z(z = 0.75 R)]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: Griffiths ex. 2.5: E_z = Q z / (4 pi eps0 (z^2 + R^2)^(3/2)))

metrics.name: rel_error[3D: far field -> point charge (r = 40 R)]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (limit: Coulomb's law, multipole limit r >> R)

metrics.name: 3D: max_rel_error_potential
metrics.how: max over 14 off-axis points, N = 256 charges

metrics.name: 3D: convergence_rate
metrics.how: observed order of the potential error in N (exponential convergence shows as a growing order)

metrics.name: rel_error[2D: line-pair field E_x at (0, d/2)]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: Griffiths ex. 2.2: E = lam/(2 pi eps0 s) L/sqrt(L^2+s^2) per segment, superposed)

metrics.name: rel_error[2D: finite line -> infinite line (s = 0.01 m, L = 1 m)]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (limit: Gauss's law for an infinite line: lam / (2 pi eps0 s))

metrics.name: 2D: max_rel_error_field
metrics.how: max over 55 points, 1024 charges per line
